Meta Quietly Releases 'Waddle World': A Tamagotchi-Style AI Pet That Creates Daily Journals

Meta's New AI Companion

Meta has launched a new application called Waddle World, blending nostalgic virtual pet mechanics with artificial intelligence to generate illustrated daily journals. Spotted by social media consultant Matt Navarra, the application has been quietly available on both the Apple App Store and Google Play since late September, though its rollout is currently restricted to adult users in the Philippines.

Described in Meta's official listings as "a daily journal disguised as a pet," the application utilizes a retro 16-bit aesthetic. Users begin by hatching a digital egg, raising a pixelated creature, and interacting with it either by typing or by using a microphone to verbally describe the events of their day. The AI pet then translates these daily accounts into written journal entries presented in its own unique voice, accompanied by matching hand-drawn style doodles.

Gameplay and Features

Beyond journaling, Waddle World incorporates traditional Tamagotchi-style care mechanics. The pixel creature experiences various moods—ranging from happy and hangry to sleepy and bored—requiring users to feed it and engage in playtime. The application also features interactive elements such as:

  • Daily prompts asking users a single silly question.
  • Weekly postcards sent to users referencing specific details mentioned during their daily chats.
  • Short, two-to-three-minute mini-games, including grocery stacking on the pet's head, star-catching while dodging bombs, and word games.
  • Collectible stamps earned through gameplay that can be exchanged for food and toys.

According to Meta, increased user interaction helps the AI better understand and reflect the user's weekly routines.

Waddle World follows a broader company pattern of developing cute AI companions. At its Connect event in September, Meta previewed the Muse Charm, an egg-shaped, keychain-sized companion device linked to its Muse AI agent that is slated for a December release. Additionally, Meta recently launched another regional tool called Style Sketch, an AI fashion application reportedly available in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For readers interested in assessing this new release, the following breakdown outlines confirmed details, ongoing uncertainties, and verification steps.

What is Confirmed

  • Availability: Waddle World is currently available for download on the App Store and Google Play, limited strictly to adult users located in the Philippines.
  • Core Functionality: The app functions as a 16-bit virtual pet where voice or text inputs about the user's day are converted into AI-generated journal entries and illustrations.
  • Additional Features: The app includes Tamagotchi-style pet care mechanics, mini-games, stamp economies, daily questions, and weekly postcards.

What Remains Unknown

  • Global Expansion: Meta has not confirmed whether Waddle World will launch in India, the United States, or other international markets.
  • Future Updates: Specific monetization plans, long-term feature roadmaps, or technical specifications regarding the AI models powering the journal generation have not been detailed.

How to Verify

Readers can verify the original reporting and check for updates regarding app availability through the official Times of India coverage. Those located in eligible regions can inspect store listings directly on the Apple App Store or Google Play.
